verdict.rationale: Cursor documents webhook subscriptions for cloud agent status changes (HMAC-signed POST notifications on ERROR/FINISHED) and Automations that can react to webhook-based triggers, showing real webhook support in an agentic context. However this is scoped to a legacy v0 API with the docs themselves noting 'Webhooks are coming soon' for v1, and there's no evidence of a general-purpose, broad event-subscription system beyond agent lifecycle events. missing for 10: v1 webhook API evidence, broader event catalog beyond agent status changes, independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook delivery reliability.
